name: Yunoki Memories
source: Yunoki Memories or YunokiRoom Memory, is a visual novel made by one of YunokiRoom's producers, Maple Channel. Follow Sakura, a middle school student  who gets her wish for you to be her boyfriend granted. A life of Anime and Slice of Life are waiting for you in this game!
translation: Yunoki Memories or YunokiRoom Memory, is a visual novel made by one of YunokiRoom's producers, Maple Channel. Follow Sakura, a middle school student  who gets her wish for you to be her boyfriend granted. A life of Anime and Slice of Life are waiting for you in this game!
